import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
comps=[]
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        if seen[i][j] or inp[i][j]==7: continue
        q=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
        while q:
            c=q.pop(); comp.append(c)
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=c[0]+di,c[1]+dj
                if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and inp[x][y]==inp[c[0]][c[1]]:
                    seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
        comps.append(comp)
blocks=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]
print('blocks',[(inp[c[0][0]][c[0][1]],sorted(c)) for c in blocks])
print('out colors',[out[c[0][0]][c[0][1]] for c in blocks])
# try orderings: top-row of block vs top-row of marker
marks=[c for c in comps if len(c)==1]
print('markers',[(inp[c[0][0]][c[0][1]],c) for c in marks])

from collections import Counter
d=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o=G['Demo pair 1 output']
def f(g):
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; cs=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or g[i][j]==bg: continue
            q=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                c=q.pop(); comp.append(c)
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=c[0]+di,c[1]+dj
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==g[c[0]][c[1]]:
                        seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
            cs.append(comp)
    marks=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for b in [c for c in cs if len(c)>1]:
        cy=sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b); cx=sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b)
        m=min(marks,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-cy)**2+abs(p[1]-cx)**2))
        col=g[m[0]][m[1]]
        for r,c2 in b: out[r][c2]=col
    return out

def comps_of(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if seen[i][j] or g[i][j]==bg: continue
            q=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                c=q.pop(); comp.append(c)
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=c[0]+di,c[1]+dj
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==g[c[0]][c[1]]:
                        seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
            out.append(comp)
    return out
def f(g):
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg); marks=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]; blocks=[c for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:min(p[0] for p in b)); marks.sort(key=lambda m:m[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for b,m in zip(blocks,marks):
        col=g[m[0]][m[1]]
        for r,c in b: out[r][c]=col
    return out
